prescriptions.why_this_matters: A LOGICAL mutation survived: a boolean operator was swapped (e.g., and to or, or not was removed) but no test detected the difference. Tests don't exercise both branches of the boolean condition.

prescriptions.expected_behavior: Function should behave differently when the logical combination changes (and vs or, with not vs without)
